_readme: Library of action beats. Timings are FRACTIONS of clip length (0.0-1.0) so the
same preset works on a 5s or a 15s clip - build_prompt.py converts them to
seconds for whatever audio you give it.
When a render comes out well, add its action line here with a name. That is how
this gets better: you stop re-inventing prompts and start reusing proven ones.
'beats' = [fraction, text]. Keep text as a physical action, not an emotion.

talking_about_outfit.use_for: describing what she's wearing, hauls, outfit checks
beats: hands resting in her lap
she glances down at her top and pinches the fabric between two fingers
she looks back up at the camera and lets the fabric go
she runs her hand down her side once, quickly
her hand settles back into her lap

excited_news.use_for: sharing something exciting, fast energetic delivery
beats: both hands raised loosely near her chest
she gestures quickly with both hands, palms turning outward
she breaks into a short genuine laugh and tilts her head to one side
one hand comes up to cover her mouth briefly, then drops
she shakes her head slightly, still smiling

casual_story.use_for: telling a story, relaxed conversational pace
beats: one hand on her thigh, the other loose
she brushes her hair behind her ear
she turns her palm upward and moves her hand in small circles as she explains
she glances away briefly as if remembering, then back to the camera
her hand lowers and she leans back a little

listing_things.use_for: counting off points, listing items, step-by-step
beats: one hand raised near her chest, fingers relaxed
she extends one finger as she starts the first point
she extends a second finger, tilting her head
she extends a third finger and pauses
she lowers her hand and shrugs one shoulder slightly
hands out of frame, shoulders relaxed
she leans slightly closer to the camera
she bites her lower lip briefly and glances down, then up
she tucks her hair behind one ear slowly
she settles back, holding eye contact with the camera

asking_question.use_for: asking the viewer something, inviting a reply
beats: hands loose in her lap
she tilts her head and raises her eyebrows
she opens one palm toward the camera as she asks
she shrugs both shoulders lightly
she holds still, waiting, with a small smile

minimal.use_for: safest option - almost no gesture, best identity retention
beats: hands out of frame, still
she tilts her head slightly to one side
she blinks and shifts her shoulders as she breathes

scenes.car_passenger: sitting in the passenger seat of a moving car, panoramic glass sunroof overhead with bright cloudy sky, green trees passing outside the side window, soft natural daylight from above
scenes.car_parked: sitting in the driver's seat of a parked car, soft overcast daylight through the windscreen, blurred street visible behind her
scenes.bedroom: sitting on the edge of a bed in a bright bedroom, soft window light from the left, white duvet and a plant behind her
scenes.kitchen: standing in a kitchen leaning against the counter, warm afternoon light, out-of-focus cupboards behind her
scenes.bathroom_mirror: standing in front of a bathroom mirror, bright even light from above, tiled wall behind her
scenes.gym: standing in a gym, mirrored wall and equipment out of focus behind her, bright overhead light

ambience.car_passenger: low engine rumble and faint road noise
ambience.kitchen: faint room tone and distant household sounds
ambience.gym: distant gym noise and faint music
